name: Goodsteel's Balanced Flameberge
summary: Goodsteel’s Balanced Flameberge is one of the items Krinkle Goodsteel seeks for his work in Tanaris. Its trail leads from Searing Gorge to the Swamp of Sorrows.

sections.title: A Place on the List
sections.body: In Searing Gorge, Krinkle Goodsteel’s ledger names a balanced flameberge among the goods he wants brought to him in Gadgetzan. Jarquia, a murloc on the eastern coast of the Swamp of Sorrows, carries the weapon. Once found, it can be taken with the other listed goods to Krinkle.

faq.answer: Krinkle Goodsteel in Gadgetzan wants the balanced flameberge, which is listed in his ledger.

faq.q: Where can I find Goodsteel’s Balanced Flameberge?
faq.answer: Jarquia, a murloc on the eastern coast of the Swamp of Sorrows, carries Goodsteel’s Balanced Flameberge.
Krinkle Goodsteel requested the weapon as one of several goods listed in his ledger.
The name uses “flameberge,” though the word is usually spelled “flamberge.”
